title: SyntheticDataGeneration-CTGAN
summary: A tutorial Jupyter notebook introducing Generative Adversarial Networks for synthetic data generation, walking through single-table and sequential synthesis and quality evaluation. It directly runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, PARSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluate_quality via the sdv package.
